name: D&D 5th Edition (2024)
description: A character sheet for the 2024 revision of D&D 5th Edition, with the SRD 5.2 catalogue of classes, subclasses and their features, species, backgrounds, feats, spells, equipment and magic items, plus active effects (conditions, exhaustion, concentration), a resource tracker and a switch for campaign house rules.
author: hunter-read
attribution: This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2 (“SRD 5.2”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. short_regain.label: Uses Regained On A Short Rest

hp_max.label: HP Maximum
hp_max.default_from: ref(klass, 'hit_die') ? ref(klass, 'hit_die') + floor((constitution - 10) / 2) + (level - 1) * (floor(ref(klass, 'hit_die') / 2) + 1 + floor((constitution - 10) / 2)) + (has_ref(species_traits, 'dwarf-dwarven-toughness-xphb') ? level : 0) + (has_ref(feats, 'tough-xphb') ? 2 * level : 0) + (has_ref(feats, 'boon-of-fortitude-xphb') ? 40 : 0) : ''

effects.label: Other Effects
effects.empty_text: Spells, potions and features acting on you - Bless, Haste, a curse.

armor_bonus.label: Armour Class Bonus
armor_bonus.placeholder: Other bonuses (a fighting style, a spell)

tool_training.label: Tools
tool_training.default_from: ref(klass, 'tool_proficiencies') != '' && ref(background, 'tool_proficiencies') != '' ? concat(ref(klass, 'tool_proficiencies'), '; ', ref(background, 'tool_proficiencies')) : concat(ref(klass, 'tool_proficiencies'), ref(background, 'tool_proficiencies'))

proficiency.formula: 2 + floor((level - 1) / 4) + sum_each(magic_items, row.proficiency_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline)
proficiency.label: Proficiency Bonus

strength_score.formula: max(max(strength + strength_bonus, min(strength + strength_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'strength'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'strength' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'strength' && row.ability_score, 0))
strength_score.label: Strength Score

item_save.formula: sum_each(magic_items, row.save_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline)
item_save.label: Saving Throw Bonus from Items

dexterity_score.formula: max(max(dexterity + dexterity_bonus, min(dexterity + dexterity_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'dexterity'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'dexterity' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'dexterity' && row.ability_score, 0))
dexterity_score.label: Dexterity Score

constitution_score.formula: max(max(constitution + constitution_bonus, min(constitution + constitution_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'constitution'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'constitution' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'constitution' && row.ability_score, 0))
constitution_score.label: Constitution Score

intelligence_score.formula: max(max(intelligence + intelligence_bonus, min(intelligence + intelligence_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'intelligence'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'intelligence' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'intelligence' && row.ability_score, 0))
intelligence_score.label: Intelligence Score

wisdom_score.formula: max(max(wisdom + wisdom_bonus, min(wisdom + wisdom_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'wisdom'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'wisdom' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'wisdom' && row.ability_score, 0))
wisdom_score.label: Wisdom Score

charisma_score.formula: max(max(charisma + charisma_bonus, min(charisma + charisma_bonus + sum_each(magic_items, row.ability_increase, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'charisma'), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_max, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'charisma' && row.ability_increase, 0))), max_each(magic_items, row.ability_score, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.ability == 'charisma' && row.ability_score, 0))
charisma_score.label: Charisma Score

skill_acrobatics.formula: signed(dexterity_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Acrobatics') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Acrobatics') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Acrobatics') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_acrobatics.label: Acrobatics

skill_animal_handling.formula: signed(wisdom_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Animal Handling') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Animal Handling') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Animal Handling') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_animal_handling.label: Animal Handling

skill_arcana.formula: signed(intelligence_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Arcana') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Arcana') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Arcana') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))

skill_athletics.formula: signed(strength_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Athletics') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Athletics') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Athletics') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))

skill_insight.label: Insight

skill_nature.label: Nature

skill_perception.label: Perception

skill_performance.formula: signed(charisma_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Performance') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Performance') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Performance') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_performance.label: Performance

skill_persuasion.formula: signed(charisma_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Persuasion') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Persuasion') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Persuasion') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_persuasion.label: Persuasion

skill_religion.formula: signed(intelligence_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Religion') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Religion') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Religion') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_religion.label: Religion

skill_sleight_of_hand.formula: signed(dexterity_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Sleight of Hand') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Sleight of Hand') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Sleight of Hand') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_sleight_of_hand.label: Sleight of Hand

skill_stealth.label: Stealth

skill_survival.formula: signed(wisdom_mod - exhaustion_d20 + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Survival') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Survival') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Survival') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_survival.label: Survival

item_check.formula: sum_each(magic_items, row.check_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline)
item_check.label: Ability Check Bonus from Items

armor_worn.formula: count_each(equipment, row.equipped && row.ac_base) + count_each(magic_items, row.equipped && not row._inline && row.base_armor && ref(row.base_armor, 'ac_base'))
armor_worn.label: Armour Worn

ac_body.formula: max(max_each(equipment, row.ac_base + (row.category == 'Heavy Armor' ? 0 : (row.category == 'Medium Armor' ? min(dexterity_mod, row.dex_cap) : dexterity_mod)), row.equipped && row.ac_base, ac_unarmored), max_each(magic_items, ref(row.base_armor, 'ac_base') + (ref(row.base_armor, 'category') == 'Heavy Armor' ? 0 : (ref(row.base_armor, 'category') == 'Medium Armor' ? min(dexterity_mod, ref(row.base_armor, 'dex_cap')) : dexterity_mod)), row.equipped && not row._inline && row.base_armor && ref(row.base_armor, 'ac_base'), 0))
ac_body.label: Armour AC

ac_items.formula: sum_each(equipment, row.ac_bonus, row.equipped && not row._inline) + sum_each(magic_items, row.ac_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.name != 'Bracers of Defense') + sum_each(magic_items, row.ac_bonus, row.name == 'Bracers of Defense' && row.equipped && row.attuned && not row._inline && armor_worn == 0 && shield_worn == 0)
ac_items.label: AC from Items

ac_defense.label: AC from the Defense Fighting Style

passive_perception.formula: 10 + wisdom_mod - exhaustion_flat + item_check + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Perception') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Perception') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Perception') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0)))
passive_perception.label: Passive Perception

item_spell_dc.formula: sum_each(magic_items, row.spell_dc_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline)
item_spell_dc.label: Spell Save DC Bonus from Items

item_spell_attack.formula: sum_each(magic_items, row.spell_attack_bonus, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline)
item_spell_attack.label: Spell Attack Bonus from Items

exhaustion_flat.label: Exhaustion: AC, Spell DC and Damage Penalty

item_walk_min.formula: max_each(magic_items, row.walk_min, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline, 0)
item_walk_min.label: Walking Speed from Items

current_speed.formula: (exhaustion >= 6 or contains(conditions, 'Grappled') or contains(conditions, 'Restrained') or contains(conditions, 'Paralyzed') or contains(conditions, 'Petrified') or contains(conditions, 'Unconscious')) ? 0 : max(0, max(speed + speed_bonus, item_walk_min) - exhaustion_speed)
current_speed.label: Current Speed

active_effects.formula: len(conditions) + (exhaustion > 0 ? 1 : 0) + (len(concentration) > 0 ? 1 : 0) + len(effects) + count_each(magic_items, row.equipped && (row.attuned or not row.attunement) && not row._inline && row.defenses)
active_effects.label: Active Effects

actions.name: short_rest
actions.label: Short rest
actions.confirm: Take a short rest? Short-rest resources, class feature uses, short-rest trait uses, short-rest item charges and Pact Magic slots come back (Rage, Channel Divinity, Wild Shape and Second Wind give back one use); spend Hit Dice by hand.

actions.name: long_rest
actions.label: Long rest
actions.confirm: Take a long rest? HP, spell slots, resources, feature and trait uses, item charges and Hit Dice come back; exhaustion drops.

validators.message: The same ability in all three background increases would be +3 - a background gives at most +2 to one ability.
The lineage belongs to another species - pick one of your species' lineages.

validators.rule: bg_ability_1 == '' or bg_ability_1 != bg_ability_2 or bg_ability_2 != bg_ability_3
validators.message: A background grants +2 and +1, or +1 to three abilities - not +3 to one.

validators.rule: ref(background, 'ability_scores') == '' or ((bg_ability_1 == '' or contains(ref(background, 'ability_scores'), bg_ability_1)) and (bg_ability_2 == '' or contains(ref(background, 'ability_scores'), bg_ability_2)) and (bg_ability_3 == '' or contains(ref(background, 'ability_scores'), bg_ability_3)))
validators.message: A background bonus is on an ability your background does not list.
More magic items are attuned than the limit allows (3, more only for an Artificer from level 10).

validators.rule: len(concentration) == 0 or not (contains(conditions, 'Incapacitated') or contains(conditions, 'Paralyzed') or contains(conditions, 'Petrified') or contains(conditions, 'Stunned') or contains(conditions, 'Unconscious'))
